cond_0001.intro: Facilitate and lead activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of production, metrology and customer claims by performing the following duties:
cond_0001.responsibilities:
The responsibilities of the Quality Technician include but not limited to the following job duties.
Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED)
Minimum one (1) year quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment
Basic understanding of assembly methods
Basic understanding of blueprints and other documents that define product specification
Must be comfortable utilizing conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices
Possess basic computer skills with experience in Microsoft Excel and Word
Preferred Requirements
Associates degree in manufacturing technology
Machining and assembly background
General knowledge of ISO procedures
Basic understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.)

Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0029.requirements: Demonstrated expertise in assembly methods. Must be proficient in utilizing conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices. Strong command of blueprints and other documents that define product specification. Advanced knowledge of ISO procedures. Solid understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.). Proven proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word. High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required; Associates degree in manufacturing technology strongly preferred. Minimum one (1) year of demonstrated quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment (machining and assembly background strongly preferred).

cond_0043.responsibilities:

Read blueprints and apply basic GD&T as needed for inspection tasks.

cond_0084.intro: Facilitate and lead activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of production, metrology and customer claims by performing the following duties:
cond_0084.responsibilities:
The responsibilities of the Quality Technician include but not limited to the following job duties.
Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0084.requirements: Basic understanding of assembly methods. Comfort using conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices. Basic understanding of blueprints and other documents that define product specification. General familiarity with ISO procedures. Basic understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.). Basic computer skills with some experience in Microsoft Excel and Word. High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required; Associate's degree in manufacturing technology preferred, or equivalent practical experience. OR around one year of quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment (machining and assembly background a plus).
cond_0084.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The responsibilities of the Quality Technician include but not limited to the following job duties.
Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0147.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Basic understanding of assembly methods.
Comfort using conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices.
Basic understanding of blueprints and other documents that define product specification.
Basic understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.).
Basic computer skills with some experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
High School Diploma or GED, or equivalent practical experience.
Around one year of quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment, or an equivalent combination of education and training.
Preferred Requirements
Working knowledge of ISO procedures.
Associates degree in manufacturing technology.
Background in machining and assembly.

cond_0373.intro: Facilitate and lead activities concerned with development, application, and maintenance of production, metrology and customer claims by performing the following duties. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the kind of inspection and quality work involved.
cond_0373.responsibilities:
The responsibilities of the Quality Technician include but not limited to the following job duties.
Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0373.requirements: Basic understanding of assembly methods. Must be comfortable utilizing conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices. Basic understanding of blueprints and other documents that define product specification. General knowledge of ISO procedures. Basic understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.). Possess basic computer skills with experience in Microsoft Excel and Word. High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required; Associates degree in manufacturing technology (preferred). OR Minimum one (1) year quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment (prefer machining and assembly background).

cond_0581.responsibilities:
The responsibilities of the Quality Technician include but not limited to the following job duties.
Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0581.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Basic understanding of assembly methods.
Must be comfortable utilizing conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices.
Basic understanding of blueprints and other documents that define product specification.
General knowledge of ISO procedures.
Basic understanding of root cause analysis (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.).
Possess basic computer skills with experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED).
Preferred Requirements
Associates degree in manufacturing technology.
Minimum one (1) year quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment (machining and assembly background preferred).

Develop and initiate standards and methods for examination, inspection, measurement and testing of material used to manufacture product.
Support the Quality Engineer function by collecting and distributing data relevant to specified projects. Support additional responsibilities as required. Assure that material meets engineering specification and customer requirements. Provide tactical quality support to operations by Investigating, Troubleshooting and Reporting on Internal (supplier and assembly issues) and External (customer complaints). Familiar with Blueprint reading and understands basic GD&T. Maintain records, certifications and documentation for completed inspections. Participate and/or lead problem solving events under the direction of a Quality Engineer. Disposition material and coordinate with purchasing on supplied material. Provide tactical quality support to operations.
cond_0596.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Demonstrated expertise in assembly methods with a solid understanding of manufacturing processes.
Strong command of conventional measuring equipment including but not limited to calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, microscopes and other types of inspection devices.
Proven ability to read and interpret blueprints and other documents that define product specification.
Advanced knowledge of ISO procedures.
Demonstrated proficiency in root cause analysis methodologies (5W1H, 5 Whys, Fishbone, etc.).
Strong computer skills with expertise in Microsoft Excel and Word.
High School Diploma or General Education Degree (GED) required; Associates degree in manufacturing technology strongly preferred.
Preferred Requirements
Minimum one (1) year of demonstrated quality inspection experience in a manufacturing environment, with a machining and assembly background strongly preferred.
